items.title: McDonald’s Looks to Fix a Value Misfire
items.summary: McDonald’s appeared to miss the mark on its U.S. value proposition. The fast-food giant’s domestic same-store sales rose just 0.8 percent in Q2, missing internal expectations after a solid start to 2026. Comps were slightly negative in April as McDonald’s lapped its successful Minecraft promotion, and U.S. comps slipped into negative territory again in July. […]
